description: BlackRoad OS Hybrid Mesh Topology: Meshtastic LoRa + Headscale/WireGuard VPN

design_rationale.lora_layer: Long-range, low-power wireless for offline-first edge nodes (LoRa 900MHz ISM band)
design_rationale.vpn_layer: WireGuard overlay for secure, routable mesh network across internet and LAN
design_rationale.hybrid_approach: LoRa for offline resilience; WireGuard for online throughput and encryption
design_rationale.data_plane: Git append-only sync across mesh edges with RoadChain provenance tracking
design_rationale.offline_first: All nodes operate offline; sync when edge connectivity available

node_types.name: Gateway Node
node_types.description: Bridge between LoRa mesh and internet/LAN. Runs Headscale + relay. Always-on.

hardware.meshtastic: RAK4631 (2.4 GHz) or similar, USB power
hardware.compute: Raspberry Pi 4 / Orange Pi / x86 mini-PC
hardware.network: Ethernet LAN + WiFi or cellular WAN

node_types.name: Relay Node
node_types.description: Extend LoRa range. Rebroadcast messages. Can be always-on or solar-powered.

hardware.compute: Optional Pi Zero or STM32 for local processing
hardware.network: None (LoRa only) or WiFi for uplink to gateway

software.git: Optional sync client if compute available

node_types.name: Edge Device
node_types.description: User device (laptop, tablet, phone). Sparse connectivity. Joins mesh when power-on.

hardware.meshtastic: T-Beam Ultra, Seeed Studio S3, or LoRa hat on Raspberry Pi

network_layout.description: Two-layer mesh: LoRa physical + WireGuard VPN logical

lora_layer.frequency: 902-928 MHz (ISM band, North America) or 868 MHz (Europe)

node_layout.description: Typical distributed topology with gateway hub
node_layout.relays: Distributed around coverage area for range extension

vpn_layer.description: WireGuard mesh: all nodes can route through Headscale

wireguard_peers.per_node: Each node gets WireGuard private key + peer config

behavior.offline: Nodes maintain local git repo, work offline
behavior.connection: When edge available, git push/pull to nearest sync peer
behavior.conflict: Last-write-wins on single LoRa channel (consensus not needed)
behavior.provenance: Every commit signed + RoadChain receipt created

sync_topology.primary: All nodes push to gateway node (central authority)
sync_topology.fallback: Nodes sync with any reachable relay if gateway offline
sync_topology.convergence: Eventual consistency (typically minutes, up to hours)

roadchain_integration.edge_clocks: All edges may be out-of-sync (RoadChain tolerates this)
roadchain_integration.ordering: Local ordering on each node; RoadChain reconciles at gateway
roadchain_integration.receipts: Placed in _receipts/ with sync metadata (node ID, timestamp)

authentication.carkeys: Permission gating at app level (not network level)

encryption.git: HTTPS or SSH (in transit over WireGuard/LoRa)

threat_model.node_compromise: Compromised node can read local data; WireGuard keys allow network access
threat_model.replay: LoRa packets not replay-protected; RoadChain detects duplicate entries
threat_model.eavesdropping: WireGuard prevents eavesdropping on internet paths; LoRa radio can be observed
threat_model.mitigation: Sensitive data encrypted at app level; RoadChain receipts signed

phase_1_prototype.scope: Single LoRa channel, single Headscale region, manual sync testing
phase_1_prototype.validation: Range testing, git sync correctness, RoadChain receipt creation

phase_2_alpha.scope: Multi-region Headscale, automatic sync, product integration testing
phase_2_alpha.validation: Real-world coverage, conflict resolution, agent handoff flows

phase_3_beta.scope: Failover testing, long-term sync stability, full product suite
phase_3_beta.validation: Load testing, incident response, performance under degradation

open_questions: Which Meshtastic device variants to use? (RAK4631 vs T-Beam vs others)
Single or multi-channel LoRa setup? (Single simpler, multi allows parallel traffic)
Git conflict resolution strategy for out-of-order merges?
RoadChain clock skew tolerance? (How stale can edge clocks be?)
Hardware redundancy for gateway? (Active-passive vs active-active?)
